name: [MOBILE] Voxlblade
desc:
Voxlblade is an RPG where you upgrade a simple sword into amazing evolutions!

1 = Equip Sword
LMB = Attack
RMB = Heavy Attack
F = Block
Shift = Run
Q = Weapon Art
R = Rune
CTRL = Mouselock

Credits:
Head Developer: Bawxol
Developers: Chibi_Drago, VersionZiila
Music: MineyRX
Contributions: Squaterra

PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: Game may have moments of intense screenshake and flashing screen effects that could harm people with photosensitive epilepsy.
